title: Error Code System: Severity Levels Overview
description: The VMC-3000 error code system uses six standardized severity levels to classify system faults and operator-required actions. Understanding these severity levels is essential for proper machine operation and maintenance planning.

CRITICAL.description: Critical system failure. Machine stops immediately. Immediate intervention required.
CRITICAL.operator_action: Stop machine immediately. Do not restart. Contact authorized technician.
examples: Complete loss of power or emergency stop activation
Coolant system failure that could damage tool or workpiece

MAJOR.description: Major fault affecting machine operation. Machine stops. Requires technician repair before restart.
MAJOR.operator_action: Stop machine operation. Wait for technician repair. Provide error code to maintenance team.

SERIOUS.description: Serious fault detected. Machine may stop or operate with limitations. Requires technician attention soon.
SERIOUS.operator_action: Stop current operation. Report to maintenance immediately. Do not start new jobs.

MINOR.description: Minor fault detected. Machine operation affected. Maintenance required soon.
MINOR.operator_action: Log error code. Notify maintenance team. May continue with reduced performance.

NOTICE.description: Informational notice. System operating normally but with advisory. No immediate action required.
NOTICE.operator_action: Acknowledge the notice. No immediate machine stop required unless directed otherwise.

ADVISORY.description: Advisory message. Informational only. No action required.
ADVISORY.operator_action: Read for information. Proceed with normal operation.

severity_action_requirements.CRITICAL: Immediate machine stop. Do not restart without authorized technician inspection and fault resolution.
severity_action_requirements.MAJOR: Stop current operation. Wait for technician repair. Do not restart machine.
severity_action_requirements.SERIOUS: Stop current operation. Notify maintenance immediately. Do not start new jobs until resolved.
severity_action_requirements.MINOR: Log error code. Notify maintenance team. Machine may continue with reduced performance.
severity_action_requirements.NOTICE: Acknowledge the notice. No immediate action required. Proceed with normal operation.
severity_action_requirements.ADVISORY: Read for information. Proceed with normal operation.
